title: 第5章 赔偿第6章 宸儿你后悔吗
content_zh:
闻言，林康脸色阴沉道：“陆狂，你说这话是什么意思？”
陆狂冷道：“林康，你耳朵聋了，没听到宸儿说他看不上你那垃圾侄女，没有猥亵她？”
林康怒喝道：“陆狂，你嘴巴最好放干净点，陆宸这个废物就是猥亵了轩儿，这是众人皆知的事。”
陆狂冷道：“众人皆知也是诬陷，我相信宸儿。”
林康冷笑道：“你相信没用，今天你陆家若是不作出赔偿，我林家定要你陆家付出代价。”
陆狂鄙视道：“林康，从小你就是我的手下败将，若是想打架，还是让你二哥来吧，你不行。”
林康大怒，但又没办法反驳，因为他确实从小就不如陆狂，林家唯一能和陆狂斗上一斗的只有他的二哥，林峰。
就在林康气得哆嗦时，一旁的林轩开口道：“二叔，你不用和他废话，他既然不愿做出赔偿，那我们就让城主府的人来要赔偿。”
陆狂眉头微皱，道：“这和城主府有什么关系？”
林康冷笑道：“陆狂，你或许还不知道，轩儿已经是城主府张扬公子的未婚妻了，陆宸这个废物猥亵他的未婚妻，你觉得城主府能饶得了这个废物？”
一听这话，整个陆家的人表情都变得凝重起来。
在天元城，四大家族虽然很强，但真正做主的还是城主府，城主府实力强大，背后更有郡王背景。
他们四大家族斗一斗，最多也就争争地盘，谁也讨不了多少好处，可如果城主府插手，陆家随时有可能被灭。
在一阵紧张的气氛中，陆宸的老爹陆毅走了出来，冷声问道：“林康，你们林家想要什么赔偿？”
林康笑道：“我们要陆家十家商铺。”
“林康，你们如此狮子大开口，怎么不去抢？”
在天元城，除了城主府产业，剩下的地盘全部被四大家族瓜分。
陆毅时代，陆家是四大家族中最强大的存在，在天元城有三十五家商铺，如今陆家落寞，只剩二十一家商铺。
如今的陆家，现有的二十一家商铺所带来的收入只能勉强满足陆家众人的修行，大家资源都省着用。
现在倒好，林康张口就要十家商铺，直接砍了一半，这让陆狂如何能够接受，这分明就是想把陆家往死里整啊。

林康冷笑道：“陆狂，这就是林家的条件，你给也得给，不给也得给，否则陆家就准备从天元城消失吧。”
如果没有城主府，林康说这种话，陆狂已经动手了，但对方有城主府撑腰，他攥紧的拳头又松开了。
陆狂很清楚城主府有多强，更清楚得罪城主府会有什么样的后果，那种后果不是他能承受得起的。
陆家其他人此刻的表情变得非常难看，他们都对陆宸投去怨恨的目光，因为就是陆宸害了他们。
听到林康拿城主府做要挟，陆乾赔笑道：“林康，十家商铺实在太多了，能不能减少一点？”
content_en:
Hearing this, Lin Kang said with a gloomy face: "Lu Kuang, what do you mean by this?"
Lu Kuang said coldly: "Lin Kang, you are deaf. Didn't you hear Chen'er say that he looked down on your trash niece and didn't molest her?"
Lin Kang shouted angrily: "Lu Kuang, you'd better keep your mouth clean. Lu Chen, this loser, molested Xuan'er. This is known to everyone."
Lu Kuang said coldly: "Everyone knows that it is a false accusation. I believe Chen'er."
Lin Kang sneered and said, "It's useless for you to believe. If your Lu family doesn't make compensation today, my Lin family will definitely make your Lu family pay the price."
Lu Kuang said contemptuously: "Lin Kang, you have been my loser since you were a child. If you want to fight, let your second brother do it. You can't."
Lin Kang was furious, but he had no way to refute, because he had indeed been inferior to Lu Kuang since he was a child. The only person in the Lin family who could fight with Lu Kuang was his second brother, Lin Feng.
Just when Lin Kang was trembling with anger, Lin Xuan on the side said: "Second uncle, you don't have to talk nonsense with him. Since he is unwilling to make compensation, then we will let the people from the City Lord's Mansion come to demand compensation."
Lu Kuang frowned slightly and said, "What does this have to do with the City Lord's Mansion?"
Lin Kang sneered and said: "Lu Kuang, you may not know that Xuan'er is already the fiancée of Young Master Zhang Yang of the City Lord's Mansion. Lu Chen, a loser, molested his fiancée. Do you think the City Lord's Mansion can spare this loser?"
Upon hearing this, the expressions of the entire Lu family became solemn.
In Tianyuan City, although the four major families are very strong, the real decision maker is the City Lord's Mansion. The City Lord's Mansion is powerful and has a background as a prince.
If the four major families fight, they will only fight for territory at most, and no one can get much benefit. However, if the city lord's palace intervenes, the Lu family may be destroyed at any time.
In a tense atmosphere, Lu Chen's father, Lu Yi, walked out and asked coldly: "Lin Kang, what compensation does the Lin family want?"
Lin Kang smiled and said, "We want ten shops in the Lu family."
"Lin Kang, you are such a lion, why don't you go and grab it?"
In Tianyuan City, apart from the property of the city lord's mansion, the rest of the land is divided up among the four major families.
During Lu Yi's era, the Lu family was the most powerful among the four major families, with thirty-five shops in Tianyuan City. Now the Lu family is lonely, with only twenty-one shops left.
In today's Lu family, the income generated by the existing 21 shops can barely meet the cultivation needs of everyone in the Lu family, so everyone is sparing their resources.
It's better now. Lin Kang asked for ten shops and cut them in half. How could Lu Kuang accept this? He clearly wanted to destroy the Lu family.
Lin Kang sneered and said: "Lu Kuang, this is the condition of the Lin family. You have to give it if you give it, and you have to give it if you don't, otherwise the Lu family will prepare to disappear from Tianyuan City."
If there was no City Lord's Mansion, Lu Kuang would have already taken action when Lin Kang said this, but with the City Lord's Mansion backing the opponent, his clenched fists loosened again.
Lu Kuang knew very well how powerful the City Lord's Mansion was, and even more clearly knew the consequences of offending the City Lord's Mansion. Such consequences were not something he could afford.
The expressions of the rest of the Lu family became very ugly at this moment. They all looked at Lu Chen with resentment, because it was Lu Chen who had harmed them.
Hearing Lin Kang's threat to the city lord's palace, Lu Gan apologized and said with a smile: "Lin Kang, ten shops are too many, can you reduce it a little?"
